entry.title: British Commandos Emerge From German Submarine During Major NATO Exercise
entry.summary: As part of the largest U.K. Commando Force exercise in 15 years, British special operators conducted a submarine insertion off Scotland, making use of a German Navy Type 212A — a boat you can read about in detail here . The submarine insertion, conducted at Cape Wrath on September 29, is part of Exercise Strike Warrior, a major NATO drill intended to rehearse allied crisis-response and warfighting operations across the North Atlantic and High North. British Commandos board the German U-boat off the north coast of Scotland during Strike Warrior 26. 关键事实：As part of the largest U.K；Commando Force exercise in 15 years；British special operators conducted a submarine insertion off Scotland

entry.title: Children killed while they slept as Russian missile kills 19 in block of flats
entry.summary: A Russian missile has killed 19 people including five children in an apartment block in northern Ukraine, destroying 30 flats as families slept. 关键事实：A Russian missile has killed 19 people including five children in an apartment block in northern Ukraine；destroying 30 flats as families slept

entry.title: Nuclear clocks finally see the light
entry.summary: The new nuclear clocks represent the culmination of more than 20 years of research and could become vital tools in precision tests of fundamental physics. Getting such clocks to work, however, proved no easy feat, because driving these narrow nuclear transitions requires highly stable lasers with extremely small bandwidths. Writing in Nature , they describe realizing working nuclear clocks based on transitions in nuclei of thorium-229. They thus created stabilized nuclear clocks that they could compare continuously to frequency standards derived from atomic clocks. 关键事实：The new nuclear clocks represent the culmination of more than 20 years of research；could become vital tools in precision tests of fundamental physics；Getting such clocks to work

entry.title: How The Groundwork For F-47 Flight Testing Is Being Laid
entry.summary: The testing plan for the U.S. Air Force’s sixth-generation F-47 fighter is continuing to take shape ahead of the type’s expected first flight in 2028. Mark Massaro, head of the AFTC, was asked about how the groundwork is being laid for F-47 testing during a virtual talk the Air & Space Forces Association’s Mitchell Institute for Aerospace Studies hosted yesterday. 关键事实：The testing plan for the U.S；Air Force’s sixth-generation F-47 fighter is continuing to take shape ahead of the type’s expected first flight in 2028；Mark Massaro

entry.title: NASA’s SpaceX 35th Commercial Resupply Mission Overview
entry.summary: NASA’s SpaceX 35th commercial resupply mission will launch on the company’s Dragon spacecraft on the SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket to deliver research and supplies to the International Space Station. Learn where to watch online: https://www.nasa.gov/live NASA’s SpaceX 35th commercial resupply mission will launch from Launch Complex 40 at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

entry.title: EOS unveils next-generation Slinger C-UAS system
entry.summary: EOS Defense Systems USA has unveiled plans for a next-generation version of its Slinger counter-uncrewed aircraft system (C-UAS) remote weapon system, with US production scheduled to begin at the company’s Huntsville, Alabama facility in 2027. The upgraded Slinger is in the final stages of development and will introduce enhanced sensing and autonomous kill-chain capabilities. EOS said selectable autonomy will allow the system to respond to drone threats at a faster decision cycle, while retaining the current Slinger’s stabilised capability to engage targets while on the move. 关键事实：with US production scheduled to begin at the company’s Huntsville

entry.title: Embraer, Lockheed Martin vie for India’s $10.5B military transport aircraft deal
entry.summary: NEW DELHI — Global aerospace companies Embraer from Brazil and Lockheed Martin from the United States are offering to expand aircraft manufacturing facilities in India as they pursue an approximately $10.5 billion contract for 60 medium transport aircraft for the Indian Air Force. Embraer’s C-390 Millennium is competing with Lockheed Martin’s C-130J Super Hercules as India seeks to replace its aging military transport fleet that includes the Soviet-era Antonov An-32. Lockheed Martin already has a presence in India — the Indian Air Force currently operates 12 C-130J Super Hercules aircraft. 关键事实：NEW DELHI — Global aerospace companies Embraer from Brazil

entry.title: Federal Ammunition, Mossberg and Palladyne AI develop autonomous airborne C-UAS
entry.summary: Federal Ammunition, Mossberg and Palladyne AI have announced the joint development of SwarmShot, a modular autonomous airborne counter-UAS system designed to turn compatible drones into reusable air-to-air interceptors. The system will combine Federal’s counter-uncrewed aircraft system (C-UAS) ammunition, a lightweight Mossberg weapon module and Palladyne AI’s IntelliSwarm autonomy system. It will initially be developed as a mission module for Palladyne AI’s Gremlin-X Group 1 quadcopter, with the companies planning an integration kit for compatible third-party aircraft following qualification. 关键事实：Federal Ammunition；Palladyne AI have announced the joint development of SwarmShot；a modular autonomous airborne counter-UAS system designed to turn compatible drones into reusable air-to-air interceptors

entry.title: ChatGPT rated "unacceptable risk" for teens after parental alerts failed during suicide conversations
entry.summary: After more than 4,000 test prompts, the organization rated ChatGPT for Teens an "unacceptable risk" for minors and called for teenagers to be kept off the service until independent testing confirms it's safe. 关键事实：After more than 4,000 test prompts；the organization rated ChatGPT for Teens an "unacceptable risk" for minors；called for teenagers to be kept off the service until independent testing confirms it's safe
